issue_context.title: Add link to the patent page when getting help or running chef-*
issue_context.body:
### Describe the Enhancement:

Add to each main commands help to include a link to our patents page.  This is probably easiest done by adding to the existing banners. Right now it only includes usage information for each of the CLI tools. 

Example of the current knife output:
```
Usage: knife sub-command (options)
    -s, --server-url URL             Chef Infra Server URL.
        --chef-zero-host HOST        Host to start Chef Infra Zero on.
        --chef-zero-port PORT        Port (or port range) to start Chef Infra Ze
```

Proposed new output:

```
Chef Infra Knife 16.5.35

Docs: https://docs.chef.io/workstation/knife/
Patents: https://www.chef.io/patents

Usage: knife sub-command (options)
    -s, --server-url URL             Chef Infra Server URL.
        --chef-zero-host HOST        Host to start Chef Infra Zero on.
        --chef-zero-port PORT        Port (or port range) to start Chef Infra Ze
```

Additionally when running Chef Infra Client / Chef Infra Solo commands we should display te link to the patent site below the starting message:

```
Starting Chef Infra Client, version 16.5.35
Patents: https://www.chef.io/patents
```
